entries.3b5f3b00e2e3fcaf: Based on the medium-term management plan (fiscal years 2025–2027), the company has set the policy of “promoting management not reliant solely on automobile production volumes” and gives top priority to transforming its organizational structure so that it can secure stable earnings even under fluctuating demand. Its product strategy calls for creating high value-added products by leveraging advanced composite molding technology for metal and resin; its regional and customer strategy designates North America, China and India as priority regions and seeks to expand sales to overseas automobile manufacturers in addition to Japanese ones; and it will improve earnings capacity through reform of the earnings structure. In the medical device business, the company aims to expand the business through the development, manufacture and sale of products aimed at minimally invasive treatment.
